diluted_eps.quote: Diluted net income per common share | $ | 2.31 | $ | 9.11

management.claim: The CEO says revenues grew 24% year on year and Google Cloud revenue growth accelerated to 82%, driven by AI demand.
management.quote: Q2 was an amazing quarter, with Alphabet revenues growing 24% year-over-year and Google Cloud revenues accelerating to 82% growth, driven by demand for AI infrastructure and AI solutions.

management.claim: Operating income rose 30% and the operating margin widened by 2 percentage points to 34%.
management.quote: Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% and operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34%.

management.claim: Other income included a net gain of $98.0 billion, mainly unrealised gains on equity securities.
management.quote: Other income reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily the result of net unrealized gains on our equity securities.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO calls Q2 an amazing quarter and describes the results as outstanding, mentioning no headwind.

guidance.text: Amazon expects third-quarter 2026 net sales of $197.0 billion to $202.0 billion, growth of 9% to 12% on the third quarter of 2025.
guidance.quote: Net sales are expected to be between $197.0 billion and $202.0 billion, or to grow between 9% and 12% compared with third quarter 2025.

management.claim: The CEO says AWS grew 36.7% year on year in Q2, its fastest growth in 18 quarters.
management.quote: AWS is booming, growing 36.7% year-over-year in Q2—our fastest growth in 18 quarters—and our AI and Chips businesses each eclipsed run rates of more than $25 billion

management.claim: The CEO says advertising grew 26% year on year.
management.quote: And, Advertising had another strong quarter with 26% year-over-year growth.

management.claim: Net income includes $53.4 billion of non-operating pre-tax other income, mainly from the investments in Anthropic.
management.quote: Second quarter 2026 net income includes non-operating pre-tax other income of $53.4 billion, primarily from our investments in Anthropic.

management.claim: Third-quarter 2026 operating income is expected to be $22.5 billion to $26.5 billion.
management.quote: Operating income is expected to be between $22.5 billion and $26.5 billion, compared with $17.4 billion in third quarter 2025.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO says AWS is booming and that there is a lot to be excited about, with more coming for customers.

guidance.text: Meta expects fourth-quarter 2026 total revenue of $73 billion to $76 billion.
guidance.quote: We expect fourth quarter 2026 total revenue to be in the range of $73-76 billion.

management.claim: Third-quarter costs include a $9.89 billion charge for the agreement with US state attorneys general.
management.quote: Third quarter 2026 costs and expenses includes a $9.89 billion charge related to this agreement.

management.claim: The CFO raises the full-year 2026 total expense outlook to $175 billion to $179 billion to include the legal charge.
management.quote: We now expect full year 2026 total expenses to be in the range of $175-179 billion.

management.claim: Capital expenditure for 2026 is expected at $135 billion to $145 billion, a narrower range than before.
management.quote: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $135-145 billion, narrowed from our prior outlook of $130-145 billion.

management.claim: The CEO says the investments are paying off and the core business is strong.
management.quote: Our investments are paying off, the core business is strong, and we're seeing velocity across the board.

tone.label: balanced
tone.reason: The CEO is upbeat, but the CFO raises the expense outlook for a large legal charge and flags active legal and regulatory matters.

management.claim: The CEO says the bank delivered record earnings and returned more than $20 million of capital to stockholders.
management.quote: We delivered record earnings and returned more than $20 million of capital to stockholders through share repurchases and a 16.7% increase in our common dividend to $0.14 per share during the third quarter.

management.claim: The President says net interest income was a record $103.7 million and the net interest margin widened five basis points to 4.33%.
management.quote: The third quarter produced record net interest income of $103.7 million and expanded our net interest margin by five basis points to 4.33% in a quarter when funding costs rose across the industry.

management.claim: The President says deposits grew at an 8.5% annualised rate while the cost of deposits rose three basis points.
management.quote: Deposits grew at an 8.5% annualized rate while our cost of deposits rose three basis points.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: Management speaks of record earnings and record net interest income, and of a strong capital position.

guidance.text: Badger Meter expects Base revenue to improve in the fourth quarter of 2026, both on the third quarter and on a year earlier.
guidance.quote: As we enter the final quarter of 2026, we continue to anticipate both sequential and year-over-year Base revenue improvement, inclusive of the fewer operating days typical for the fourth fiscal quarter

management.claim: The CEO says the quarter delivered continued sequential improvement in sales and operating profit.
management.quote: We were pleased with our third quarter financial results delivering continued sequential sales and operating profit improvement

management.claim: Operating earnings rose 4% to $47.7 million and the operating margin widened to 20.2% from 19.6%.
management.quote: Operating earnings increased 4% year-over-year to $47.7 million, with operating profit margins of 20.2% versus 19.6% in the prior year comparable quarter.

management.claim: The CEO says the company is focused on cost management and on material cost pressures from the electronics supply chain.
management.quote: We remain steadfastly focused on cost management actions to mitigate the uneven 2026 sales cadence, while effectively addressing ongoing material cost pressures related to broad electronics supply chain dynamics.

tone.label: balanced
tone.reason: The CEO is pleased with the quarter and expects growth, but names an uneven 2026 sales cadence and material cost pressures.
